part.text:
Fixed. In `formatter<group_digits_view<T>>::format` (include/fmt/format.h:7506), the value was cast directly to an unsigned type, so negatives wrapped around (e.g. `-12345` → `18,446,744,073,709,539,271`). Now it uses `detail::make_write_int_arg(t.value, specs.sign)` to compute the absolute value and `-` prefix before calling `write_int`, matching how `loc_writer` handles signed integers.

Verification: the `group_digits_view` test (including negative cases) passes, and all 20 ctest suites pass with no regressions.
